title: Allowing public ACLs or policies on a S3 bucket is security-sensitive
description: Allowing public ACLs or policies on an Amazon S3 bucket can expose sensitive data to unauthorized users. S3 buckets are used to store data in the cloud, and improper configuration of access control lists (ACLs) or bucket policies can make the data publicly accessible. This is a security-sensitive operation that can lead to data breaches, compliance violations, and unauthorized access to critical information.
message: Public ACLs or policies on S3 buckets can expose sensitive data. Review and restrict access to ensure only authorized users can access the bucket.
impact: Sensitive data stored in S3 buckets may be exposed to the public, leading to data breaches, loss of confidentiality, and potential regulatory non-compliance.
recommendation: Review all S3 bucket ACLs and policies to ensure that public access is not allowed. Use AWS S3 Block Public Access settings to prevent accidental exposure. Regularly audit bucket permissions and follow the principle of least privilege.

noncompliant.code:
import boto3
s3 = boto3.client('s3')
s3.put_bucket_acl(Bucket='my-bucket', ACL='public-read')
# or
s3.put_bucket_policy(Bucket='my-bucket', Policy='...policy allowing public access...')
noncompliant.description: This code sets a public ACL or policy on an S3 bucket, making its contents accessible to anyone on the internet.

compliant.code:
import boto3
s3 = boto3.client('s3')
s3.put_bucket_acl(Bucket='my-bucket', ACL='private')
# or
s3.put_bucket_policy(Bucket='my-bucket', Policy='...policy restricting access to specific users...')
compliant.description: This code ensures that the S3 bucket is not publicly accessible and access is restricted to authorized users only.

devsecops.security: Exposure of sensitive data due to misconfigured S3 bucket permissions.
devsecops.automation: Automated tools should regularly audit S3 bucket permissions.
devsecops.compliance: Helps meet compliance requirements such as GDPR, HIPAA, and PCI DSS by preventing unauthorized data exposure.

why_is_this_an_issue: Publicly accessible S3 buckets are a common cause of data breaches. Attackers can easily find and exploit such buckets to access or steal sensitive information. Ensuring that S3 buckets are not publicly accessible is critical for maintaining data security and compliance.
how_to_fix: Use AWS S3 Block Public Access settings to prevent public ACLs and policies. Regularly review and audit all S3 bucket permissions. Remove any policies or ACLs that allow public access, and restrict access to only those who need it.
